name: ci-native-verify
goal: The existing workflow verifies the exact commit on Apple silicon macOS with one pinned, selected and logged Xcode; the Linux full check and every verification obligation stay as they are

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Both jobs ran on Ubuntu, where the remote-mobile-native scenario cannot produce its Swift, SDK and simulator evidence. Expected: Full check unchanged on ubuntu-latest; Verify the exact commit on macos-15 arm64 with Xcode 26.3 pinned by DEVELOPER_DIR, selected with xcode-select, logged, and every other obligation kept

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: bunx vitest run test/ci-native-verify.test.ts (sha256 506cec235ea7) on workflow fba3bb0d4ab0: 3 failed (runs-on macos-15, pinned and selected Xcode, macOS steps and direct verify run), 3 guards passed; existing test/ci-workflow.test.ts 4 passed. /tmp/ci-red.txt

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Only the verify job of .github/workflows/harness-verify.yml changed (sha256 e6f6479adba1): macos-15, DEVELOPER_DIR for Xcode 26.3, a selection and logging step that fails when it is absent, browser without Linux packages, brew git-lfs and ffmpeg, verify run without xvfb. No new workflow, permission, approval or mapping

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same test file: 6 passed; test/ci-workflow.test.ts 4 passed (/tmp/ci-green.txt). The text before the verify job is identical to HEAD; the file parses as YAML with jobs check and verify; prettier, eslint and tsc clean; units check valid. No hosted run was performed

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
